question: Does the H-938/H-910 mirror-order pair decide whether local 034 is the vertical/rake 415-like component or the loop/leaf component?
answer: It decides only conditionally. Under the recorded local R/L direction on both companion sides, 034 maps to the loop/leaf component in H-938 B and H-910 B, so direct 034=415 component identity is rejected. If the recorded direction policy fails and both sides must be forced L/R, the assignment flips and 034 maps to the vertical/rake component. That counterfactual is not accepted without a source/transcription-policy reason.
